tbesh_html:
§ Kibroth-hattaavah = "graves of lust"
a station of Israel in the wilderness 3 campsites away from Sinai near the gulf of Akabah

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Kibroth-hat-Taavh, a place in the Desert
strongs_1890.derivation: from the feminine plural of H6913 (קֶבֶר) and H8378 (תַּאֲוָה) with the article interposed; graves of the longing;
